existing_claim: V-B duplicate-safe CV is primary model/representation selection authority
plausible_failure_mechanism: Dependencies beyond duplicate families, especially preprocessing/source fingerprints, create subgroup-specific model rankings that V-B aggregate hides
discriminating_test: Stratify exact non-protected V-B OOF predictions by sample-count modulo-128 preprocessing fingerprint and compare model ranking
observed_evidence: Dominant remainder categories 0/43/86/30/94; V-B rank reverses in remainder 86 (ExtraTrees 0.6542 > RBF 0.6140) and remainder 30 (BasicLogReg 0.5608 > RBF 0.5204); remainder 0/43 favor RBF
consequence: Keep V-B primary, but add a sample-count/preprocessing-source diagnostic stress; do not treat aggregate V-B alone as sufficient rank-robustness evidence

existing_claim: V-A is a defensible secondary row-level competition-mimic/retrieval-aware view
plausible_failure_mechanism: Train/test allocation could be correlated with source, prompt, speaker, duration or latent neighborhoods even if ID is interleaved
discriminating_test: Review split association plus regularized nonlinear adversarial diagnostics after excluding cross-split duplicate families
observed_evidence: ID/order remains near random; speaker/prompt/latent split associations are weak, but regularized full-acoustic ExtraTrees gives AUC 0.6196-0.6441 over 3 seeds; 30 same-config label permutations have p95 0.5483 and max 0.5576
consequence: V-A may remain secondary, but weak-to-modest residual shift should be tightened to detectable moderate nonlinear shift; no evidence supports replacing V-A with a specific hidden-group split

existing_claim: Class-stratified 20/30/40/50% Monte Carlo adequately bounds hidden public/private uncertainty
plausible_failure_mechanism: Hidden public/private membership may be correlated by prompt/source/latent subgroup rather than conditionally IID within class
discriminating_test: Force/enrich plausible observable subgroups into pseudo-private sets, random-fill to fixed private fractions, and recompute official 0.4/0.6 weighted ranking over existing VA pipeline OOF predictions
observed_evidence: At 20% private with prompt-sim-0.90 beyond-duplicate rows enriched, ExtraTrees is top in 49.2% of 250 replicates vs RBF 32.4%, mean RBF-minus-best-alt -0.0064. With latent k4 cluster 3 enriched, FullLogReg is top 86.4% at 20% and 92.8% at 30%, mean gaps -0.0203/-0.0083
consequence: Current emulator does not bound correlated hidden allocation risk; extend emulator before treating it as final private-LB robustness authority

existing_claim: 0.95 duplicate graph and 78-test retrieval lane are robust
plausible_failure_mechanism: Connected-component chaining could join endpoints that are not pairwise convincing
discriminating_test: Recompute normalized native-waveform cosine for every within-component pair and every cross-split test-train pair
observed_evidence: 227 components checked; zero components contain any pair below 0.95; minimum within-component pairwise cosine 0.96026; minimum cross-split test-train cosine 0.96189
consequence: No evidence of transitive false joins; retrieval membership survives this attack

existing_claim: ECAPA speaker-like structure is diagnostic only; no authoritative V-C
plausible_failure_mechanism: A stable threshold/algorithm regime might add independent speaker groups beyond duplicate families
discriminating_test: Compare agglomerative vs DBSCAN assignments and perturb/subsample ECAPA embeddings across thresholds
observed_evidence: Agglomerative-vs-DBSCAN ARI 0.9885 at d0.20 and 0.9486 at d0.25, but only 6 and 33 beyond-duplicate clips; at d0.30/d0.35 coverage grows while algorithm ARI collapses to 0.6067/0.2731
consequence: No regime simultaneously gives material independent coverage and robust identification; rejection of authoritative V-C survives

existing_claim: Prompt structure beyond duplicates is too limited for authoritative grouping
plausible_failure_mechanism: Small repeated-prompt subsets may matter for ranking even when aggregate AMI is near zero
discriminating_test: Evaluate exact V-B OOF model ranking on beyond-duplicate prompt clusters and emulator enrichment
observed_evidence: At prompt sim0.90 beyond-duplicate subset, ExtraTrees 0.5479 > RBF 0.4553; at sim0.95, ExtraTrees 0.5428 > RBF 0.4193
consequence: Prompt grouping remains diagnostic, but it must enter correlated-allocation rank stress rather than being dismissed solely by aggregate AMI

existing_claim: Joint latent regimes are too weak/unstable for authoritative validation
plausible_failure_mechanism: Even weak latent regimes could concentrate hidden-private difficulty and reverse rankings
discriminating_test: Use non-protected latent assignments as sensitivity strata, without naming them acted/spontaneous
observed_evidence: Several latent clusters reverse cheap-model rank; k4 cluster 3 is the strongest correlated-allocation stress, but clustering has low silhouette and only moderate adjacent-k stability
consequence: Do not create latent authority from these clusters; use them only as adversarial emulator scenarios

existing_claim: Only 75/636/878 is a verified duplicate-label conflict; broader truth is unresolved
plausible_failure_mechanism: Wider annotation noise could bias model selection
discriminating_test: Review duplicate-family disagreement and independent representation/model-disagreement evidence without relabeling
observed_evidence: No second duplicate-family label conflict was found; model/neighbor disagreement cannot establish annotation truth without ground truth
consequence: No justified relabeling or noise-specific validation redesign; keep known conflict as diagnostic
